node.title: Re: Counting text with ligatures
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I assume what you want to count is "[wp://Grapheme]s" (see also [doc://perluniintro]). You should use Perl v5.12 or better; here are a couple of ways (see [doc://perlrebackslash#Misc|\X] and [doc://perlrebackslash#\b{},-\b,-\B{},-\B|\b{gcb}], as well as my post [id://1198757|here]):

my $string = "k\x{0301}u\x{032D}o\x{0304}\x{0301}n"; print "length: ",length($string),"\n"; # wrong way my $len = () = $string=~/\X/g; print "len: $len\n"; my @graphs = split /\X\K(?=\X)/, $string; print "graphs: ", 0+@graphs, "\n"; # in Perl v5.22+: my @graphs2 = split /\b{gcb}/, $string; print "graphs2: ", 0+@graphs2, "\n"; __END__ length: 8 len: 4 graphs: 4 graphs2: 4
